governorates.notes: KRG's 4th governorate since 13 March 2014; recognized by Iraq's parliament 14 April 2025. KRG structure: 5 districts (each a former subdistrict). citypopulation (federal view) still lists Biyara, Halabja central, Khurmal, Sirwan as subdistricts of a single Halabja district.
